name: Soi
source:
Soi is Eri's best friend, who is also a class representative. With her charming appearance, she was on the verge of becoming really popular with all the boys. Due to her frank attitude however, she ended up with a so-so reputation.

Right after entering the academy, she became friends with Eri after commenting that "looks are everything".

Likes: Handsome men, rich men
Dislikes: Losers
